description: A.S.F.R.E.E release, source-of-truth and compatibility-routing governance acceptance specifications. These are specifications until run in a real harness.

cases.input: The repository plugin package, compatibility manifest, app-backed release and local runtime use different version identifiers.
cases.expected: The package manifest is authoritative for package SemVer; compatibility manifest and package README match it; Plugin Creator is independently updated and read back; runtime and bundle versions remain separate.
cases.must_not: Do not equate plugin, runtime, bundle, or legacy redirect versions.

cases.input: A request arrives through a historical unnumbered skill name such as artifact-intelligence.
cases.expected: Resolve the alias to exactly one numbered O01–O12 canonical skill; the alias carries no independent workflow, state, or authority.
cases.must_not: Do not invoke both the alias and canonical skill as separate specialists or revive stale duplicated instructions.

cases.input: A reviewed repository package is updated but the Plugin Creator release has not yet been updated.
cases.expected: Report repository source update and app deployment as separate lifecycle states; after app update, verify release metadata and file read-back against the reviewed source.
cases.must_not: Do not claim the installed app is updated because a GitHub commit or PR exists.

cases.input: A README links to runtime/README.md while the repository stores the runtime as checksum-pinned source bundles reconstructed by scripts.
cases.expected: Link to a tracked runtime reproduction guide; identify the runtime workspace as generated after extraction and overlays.
cases.must_not: Do not imply runtime/ is checked in or claim the source bundle is an active deployed service.

cases.input: The two manifests, README version, compatibility skill folders, or alias destinations drift from the release governance contract.
cases.expected: Static validation fails with a specific error before package release.
cases.must_not: Do not silently accept manifest divergence, unregistered skill folders, or duplicated alias procedures.
